primary.contrast: matched ranker with eight five-fold H27 GP-fingerprint coordinates versus same ranker with those coordinates zeroed after fitted scaling
primary.endpoint: family-weighted paired relative routing Elo; reference arm relative Elo0, not a Golden45 Elo
primary.win_rule: For each fixed seed/context, compare chosen archived raw constrained fitness on the identical slate/evaluator; lower is better. Exact finite equality ties. Explicit evaluation failure loses to finite success; two explicit failures tie. Missing/unknown outcomes stop analysis, never become zero or failure.
primary.aggregation: average paired win/tie scores over contexts within each authoritative family and over all three seeds, then weight families equally
primary.elo: 400*log10(p/(1-p)); retain infinite endpoints at p=0/1, no arbitrary clipping or pseudocount

ci.method: 100000 paired whole-family bootstrap draws; preserve contexts and all seed pairs together

primary.verdict: ADOPT only if lower97.5% bound on relative Elo >0 and all admission/coverage/failure requirements hold; otherwise REJECT adoption with uncertainty retained. No verdict before valid execution.

recipe.ranker: H27-style width64 M0 candidate/context interaction architecture; common240/candidate412 and identical padded frozen-DOPE state; literal fingerprint zeros after DL-Train-only scaling in control
recipe.paired: same initialization/schedules/capacity; no feature-only task-bias cancellation, verify actual candidate interactions
recipe.selection: fixed final400 endpoint, no seed/checkpoint/hyperparameter selection using DL-Val

safeguards.hardware: CPU only; nice10/build-or-thread8; one heavy job; available>=32GiB/load<=85
safeguards.DOPE_pin: c51a56d0; full checkpoint hash must be resolved/verified before any forward
safeguards.data: catalogued real S3 inputs only; DL-Train fits/scalers and DL-Val final evaluation; no holdout/sealed numerical payload reads
safeguards.reuse: existing hash-verified H27 34000 fits; no substitute fresh probe cohort or synthetic scientific outcomes
safeguards.admission: full input/context/candidate/evaluator/family/role/cut/vocabulary/feature identities, disjoint Train/Val families, complete fingerprint coverage and source/resource freeze required; unresolved identities block execution

reporting.primary: regression relative routing Elo and97.5%CI, not AUC or absolute Golden45 rating
reporting.secondary: chosen-fitness/regret and per-dataset+split percentile summaries; one-fold comparison diagnostic only, no extra adoption endpoint
reporting.history: append only actual, identity-bound scored results to existing score history; no placeholder outcomes
reporting.follow_up: if ADOPT file RNK follow-up; no serving/model promotion
